pro_course_detail.title: 📔 Exam Preparation / IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:

📔 From the first lesson follow a simulated approach that matches the conditions of the real IELTS exam 
📔 You will develop your speed and confidence when preparing for test day 
📔 Develop a wide range of tips, tricks and hacks to help you increase your score 
📔 We will focus on speaking, reading, writing and listening.

pro_course_detail.title: 🚴‍♂️ Fast Track My English (Extra Material Included)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you are looking to improve your English in the most efficient way possible, then this is the course for you. 

The first step we will take is to discuss a learning plan in your first lesson. Afterwards, in each ‘Fast Track Your English’ lesson, we will tackle a wide range of English vocabulary to help you progress as fast as possible. I will also present you with a learning process that will help you remember everything that you have learnt. 

In this course, I will:

🌟 help you identify which areas of your language need the most development 
🌟 create a plan and a course to help you learn in the most efficient way 
🌟 provide you with a weekly task to complete, to help you stay engaged with your language learning
🌟 set up a personal Google document, this way you can keep track of all the fantastic vocabulary you will be learning 
🌟 provide you with monthly summaries and share with you some key learning hacks. This way we can talk together about your learning techniques and methods. We can discuss ideas and figure out together the most optimal way for you to learn. 
🌟 focus on conversation, however, we will also implement some reading, writing and grammar exercises to help you fast track your learning. 
🌟 provide you with a learning structure that is not only tailored to you personally, but is created to help you have the most productive and enjoyable lesson 
🌟 if necessary, we can use a hybrid course to help you develop your English vocabulary, business English and conversational skills. 

I look forward to starting this learning journey with you. See you in class.

pro_course_detail.title: 🗣 Conversation Practice (Material NOT Included)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you sometimes get stuck when speaking about a topic in English? Do you lack confidence and wonder sometimes if you are using the right words, collocations or expressions? Are you also looking to practice speaking about a wide range of topics that you would naturally talk about with your family, friends or colleagues? Or are you preparing to give a presentation? If you want to develop your confidence and be prepared for any situation in English, then this course is for you. 

🌟 This will suit students who are looking to develop a higher level of conversational skill in the English language. 
🌟 Your confidence will increase and you will feel comfortable speaking with natives in a natural setting 
🌟 You will learn more about who you are as an English speaker 
🌟 We will cover all types of conversations that you will likely encounter with colleagues, friends and family
🌟 This method includes helping you develop your ability to also ask questions in English 

The first level of questions will be general and cover a range of topics such as shows, movies, lifestyle, languages and traditions. The second level of questions will focus on a wider range of topics such as culture, values, stereotypes, types of living and motivation. The third level will bring in a much wider range of discussion questions, aimed to bring out the greatest conversationalist in you. This will include topics such as yoga, choosing a path in life, overcoming fear, empowerment, self-compassion, cashless societies, megacities, A.I. spending habits, legal and economic issues. 

**You are also more than welcome to bring any topics that you wish to talk about into the classroom. 
 
This is typically for higher level students who are looking to increase their confidence speaking English whilst talking about a wide range of topics. Although depending on your speaking ability the questions can be tailored to suit your level.

I look forward to speaking with you :)

pro_course_detail.title: Learn English for adults: Study and Conversation Classes (study for IELTS, conversation or specific learning goals)
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's meet your English learning goals! Lessons will be tailored to you for your preferences in learning and to your level of English. 

Our classes can be more structured classes e.g. studying grammar, focusing on pronunciation and sounding natural, exercises to improve specific skills (e.g. reading skills), or practicing specific situations (for example, booking a hotel while travelling, going to the doctor or taking part in a meeting at work). If you are studying for IELTS we can work towards this in class, covering all four disciplines. Or if you would like the maximum amount of conversation in your class we'll focus more on communication and speaking naturally. 

As with all my classes, the exact format of the lessons is very flexible and depends on the what the student would like and what their learning style is. My lessons are a safe space to make mistakes, explore the language and push yourself further, with a patient and flexible teacher (my students always tell me this!).

pro_course_detail.title: Learn English with singing- lessons for adults (B2- C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you have some prior knowledge of English and are interested in learning and practicing English through music and singing, this class is for you! Singing can make language much more memorable: if you are anything like me you can’t remember from last week but you can recite the words to a childhood song with no problem! 

These sessions would work well as a way to build on what you’ve already learnt in English:

- expand your vocabulary, 
- improve your pronunciation, 
- learn something about culture through the songs, 

and learn English while doing something you enjoy. 

The selection of songs will be appropriate depending on your level of English, and chosen to teach certain aspects of the language. We will spend some time going over the lyrics of the songs with some further explanations and further examples of phrases and words used in the song. We will use written documents for lyrics/further explanations or background information, and music videos and audios as a way to practice English listening skills.

- Practice of different tenses
- Specific subject matters/specific vocabulary
- Common idioms/expressions

We’ll learn to sing the song concentrating on pronunciation while also learning the tune, the rhythm and the beat of the song.

Or if you have some favourite songs you would like to learn we can start from there. 

It doesn’t matter if you have never sung before (other than in the shower :) ), if you feel you don’t have much musical skill or if you are a little bit shy to start with-- we’ll take it slow. We can focus more or less on the musical side of things depending on your preference-  we will discuss this when we discuss your aims for the sessions. This would include singing at the right pitch, note-finding and rhythm.

Any questions please send me a message and I will get back to you as soon as possible. 
Kick-start your musical English journey with me today, and learn in a whole new way :)

Helping my students to put the theory into speaking practice is of vital importance for me as an English teacher.
teacher_info.teaching_style: On my profile I offer two types of lessons, speaking and study. In the first we will practice your English speaking skills by talking about a variety of different topics or discussing an article or video. I will also correct your mistakes using the chat bar and answer any questions you may have about English. In the latter we will use different teaching materials, exercises and activities to improve your English skills and knowledge within a specific area of English such as grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary etc. I’m very patient with my students and always provide clear and concise explanations. Helping you to put the theory into practice with a native teacher.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Preparation Toolkit | Field and role-specific vocabulary, phrases
pro_course_detail.description:
Focus:
Adding relevant vocabulary, optimising pronunciation, role playing common scenarios, answering common + tricky questions; building confidence. 

In this lesson you will prepare for your upcoming interview by looking at your current performance, improving it with structured feedback, and replicating an interview setting to build confidence and response fluency.

We will: 

– Create / practice / polish your self-introduction 
– Answer / polish responses to behavioural interview questions (common + tricky + unique to you)
– Conduct mock interviews to practice and build confidence

To stay organised and to keep track of your progress, we’ll be using Google docs, where all our notes will be captured for you to review in your own time.

We'll use Google Meet or the Italki classroom for lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced Business English for Work | Industry-specific vocabulary, phrases, idioms
pro_course_detail.description:
Focus: 
Boosting your confidence, accuracy and performance in a business setting.

In this lesson we’ll work on specific Business English aspects based on your needs. 

We will: 

– Understand your current status and goals for working on Business English 
– Craft scenarios and materials that will help you in your real-life  business situations
– Role play situations that will simulate your actual usage of the vocabulary, phrases and pronunciation we introduce and polish

To stay organised and to keep track of your progress, we’ll be using Google docs, where all our notes will be captured for you to review in your own time.

We'll use Google Meet or the Italki classroom for lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: CV, Resume, Cover Letter | Proofreading, correction, feedback
pro_course_detail.description:
Focus: 
Delivering an outstanding CV, Resume or Cover Letter.

In this lesson I proofread, edit and polish your CV, Resume or Cover Letter. 

I make sure the text of your document: 

– Incorporates optimal action-focused vocabulary, presenting you in the best light
– Shines a humble spotlight on your achievements, knowledge and skills
– Uses top-notch grammar, spelling and punctuation

After I've finished polishing the text of your document, you get:

– Written feedback from me on the strengths of your document (what was good)
– Personalised tips for improving all your docs in the future (what I improved, why and what to watch out for in the future) 

Prior to scheduling a CV / Proofreading lesson, please message me – we'll agree on a specific slot to schedule on! 

Please note the document is edited offline – I send the polished, finalised document to you on the day of the lesson. This includes one round of tweaks and minor additions to the document, if necessary!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English | Fluency, accuracy | Boost your confidence!
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversational English | Fluency, accuracy | Boost your confidence!

Focus: 
Improving fluency and pronunciation, broadening vocabulary range, boosting confidence 

We’ll speak about topics you’re interested in, using guiding questions, discussion points and materials like articles and videos to stimulate a lively discussion. 

Speaking is closely tied to listening, and the materials we’ll use will give you lots of speaking practice as well as listening practice. 

When you’re practising at home for this course using materials I send you (videos, articles, or similar), I’ll ask you to write down any vocabulary items you’re not familiar with. We’ll go through this list at the beginning of our next lesson, to make sure you are using them correctly. 

To stay organised and to keep track of your progress, we’ll be using Google docs, where all our notes will be captured for you to review in your own time.

We'll use Google Meet or the Italki classroom for lessons.
